title: Deep underground bases at S4 and Dulce
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Deep underground bases at S4 and Dulce, about 20th century at New Mexico (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: S4 Area 51, Nevada; Dulce, New Mexico

tellings.quote: There are also deep underground military bases across the United States and sometimes ones rumored to house other beings at S4 Area 51 or Dulce, New Mexico.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there are deep underground military bases across the United States, and that some are rumored to house other beings. He names two: S4, said to be a site at Area 51, a secretive military base in Nevada, and one under Dulce, a town in New Mexico. He draws on men who have told such stories, including Bob Lazar, Phil Schneider, Dan Burisch and Richard Sauder.
